channel.title: Wire — Security
channel.description: Security from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
item.description: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places. (6 sources: cloudflare, hackernews, javascriptweekly, lobsters, reactstatus, rprogramming)

item.title: A UAF turned RCE
item.description: In the curl 8.23.0 release we shipped a fix for one of the worst vulnerabilities in curl in a long time. We grade it severity HIGH. It is known as CVE-2026-92392 with the title HTTP/2 upload Use-After-Free. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: ZCS Command Injection via SNMP Handlers Enables Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
item.description: A critical remote command execution vulnerability in the Zimbra Collaboration Suite, identified as CVE-2026-73570, poses risks by allowing unauthorized access to mailbox data and credentials. (1 source: infoq)
